meta.note: Checked page by page against the official August '26 PDF (linked from the Kill Team downloads page). Ploy costs: 1CP (core rules; cards print none).
meta.composition: 1 operative from Captain / Assault Intercessor Sergeant / Intercessor Sergeant, plus 5 others. Other than WARRIOR operatives, each operative can be taken only once.
meta.chapterVeteran: Chapter Veteran (both Sergeants only): that operative gains one ADDITIONAL chapter tactic for the battle. Unlike primary and secondary tactics, it need not be the same one each battle in a campaign or tournament.

effects.name: Command Re-roll
effects.text: After rolling your attack or defence dice, re-roll one of those dice. No limit per turning point.
effects.hint: After rolling your attack or defence dice, re-roll one of them.

effects.name: Astartes
effects.text: During each friendly operative's activation, it can perform either two Shoot actions or two Fight actions. If two Shoot, a bolt weapon must be selected for at least one; if it's a bolt sniper rifle or heavy bolter, 1 additional AP must be spent for the second action if both use that weapon. Each friendly operative can counteract regardless of its order.
effects.hint: Two Shoot or two Fight actions (one Shoot with a bolt weapon; a second shot with the same bolt sniper rifle or heavy bolter costs +1 AP). Can counteract regardless of order.

effects.name: Combat Doctrine
effects.text: Select a doctrine. Friendly operatives' weapons gain Balanced (re-roll one attack die) when the doctrine's condition is met.

options.name: Devastator
options.hint: Balanced (re-roll one attack die) if the target is more than 6" away.

options.name: Tactical
options.hint: Balanced (re-roll one attack die) if the target is within 6".

options.name: Assault
options.hint: Balanced (re-roll one attack die) when fighting or retaliating.

effects.hint: Your weapons have Balanced while your doctrine's condition is met.

effects.name: And They Shall Know No Fear
effects.text: Ignore any changes to friendly operatives' stats from being injured, including their weapons' stats.
effects.hint: Injured operatives use their normal stats this turning point (weapons included).

effects.name: Indomitus
effects.text: When an enemy shoots a friendly operative, if you roll two or more fails you can discard one to retain another as a normal success.
effects.hint: When shot: two or more fails? Discard one to retain another as a normal success.

effects.name: Adaptive Tactics
effects.text: Change your secondary Chapter Tactic. It reverts at the end of the turning point.
effects.hint: Swap your secondary chapter tactic until the end of the turning point.

effects.name: Shock Assault
effects.text: Use when a friendly operative is performing the Fight action during an activation in which it performed the Charge action, at the start of the Resolve Attack Dice step. Until the end of that action its melee weapon has Shock, and the first time you strike during that sequence, inflict 1 additional damage (max 7).
effects.hint: Fighting after a Charge: Shock, and +1 damage on your first strike (max 7).

effects.name: Transhuman Physiology
effects.text: In the Roll Defence Dice step when being shot, retain one normal success as a critical success.
effects.hint: When shot, in the Roll Defence Dice step: retain one normal success as a critical.

effects.name: Wrath of Vengeance
effects.text: Use when a friendly operative is counteracting. It can perform an additional 1AP action for free during that counteraction, but both actions must be different.
effects.hint: When counteracting: one extra free 1AP action (both actions different).

effects.name: Adjust Doctrine
effects.text: During a friendly operative's activation, before or after an action, change the Combat Doctrine you selected this turning point.
effects.hint: Before or after an action: change the Combat Doctrine you selected this turning point.

effects.name: Purity Seals
effects.text: Once per turning point, when a friendly operative is shooting, fighting or retaliating, if you roll two or more fails you can discard one to retain another as a normal success.
effects.hint: Once per turning point, shooting, fighting or retaliating: two or more fails? Discard one to retain another as a normal success.

effects.name: Auspex
effects.text: Once per turning point, when a friendly operative performs a Shoot action and you are selecting a valid target: until the end of that activation or counteraction, enemy operatives within 8" of it cannot be obscured.
effects.hint: Once per turning point when shooting: enemies within 8" of this operative can't be obscured until its activation ends.

effects.name: Tilting Shields
effects.text: Once per turning point, when a friendly operative is fighting or retaliating, after your opponent rolls attack dice but before re-rolls, they cannot retain results of less than 6 as critical successes for that sequence.
effects.hint: Once per turning point, fighting or retaliating, after they roll: they can't retain results below 6 as criticals this sequence.

effects.name: Chapter Reliquaries
effects.text: You can use the Wrath of Vengeance firefight ploy for 0CP if the specified friendly operative has an Engage order.
effects.hint: Wrath of Vengeance is free if the operative has an Engage order.

costOverrides.condition: the operative has an Engage order

effects.name: Heroic Leader
effects.text: Once per turning point, ONE of: use a firefight ploy for 0CP if the Captain is the specified operative (not Command Re-roll); use Combat Doctrine when you activate an operative, paying its CP cost as normal, if the Captain is in the killzone and not within enemy control range — not if you already used that ploy this turning point; or use Adjust Doctrine for 0CP under those same conditions.

costOverrides.condition: the Captain is the operative this ploy specifies · one Heroic Leader use per turning point
Captain in the killzone and not within an enemy control range · one Heroic Leader use per turning point

effects.hint: Once per turning point: a firefight ploy free for the Captain (not Command Re-roll), Combat Doctrine on activation, or Adjust Doctrine free.

effects.name: Iron Halo
effects.text: Once per battle, when an attack dice inflicts Normal Damage on the Captain, ignore that damage.
effects.hint: Once per battle: ignore one attack die's Normal Dmg on the Captain.

effects.name: Optics
effects.text: Action (1AP): until the start of this operative's next activation, whenever it's shooting, enemy operatives cannot be obscured. Cannot be performed while within control range of an enemy operative.
effects.hint: 1AP: until its next activation, when this operative shoots, enemies can't be obscured. Not in enemy control range.

effects.name: Doctrine Warfare
effects.text: Once per battle each: Combat Doctrine costs 0CP when you select Assault, and 0CP when you select Tactical, if this operative is in the killzone.

costOverrides.condition: Assault Intercessor Sergeant is in the killzone · once per battle
Assault Intercessor Sergeant is in the killzone · once per battle

effects.hint: Once per battle each: Combat Doctrine is free when you pick Assault or Tactical (Sergeant in the killzone).

effects.name: Doctrine Warfare
effects.text: Once per battle each: Combat Doctrine costs 0CP when you select Devastator, and 0CP when you select Tactical, if this operative is in the killzone.

costOverrides.condition: Intercessor Sergeant is in the killzone · once per battle
Intercessor Sergeant is in the killzone · once per battle

effects.hint: Once per battle each: Combat Doctrine is free when you pick Devastator or Tactical (Sergeant in the killzone).

effects.name: Camo Cloak
effects.text: Whenever an operative is shooting this operative, ignore the Saturate weapon rule. This operative has the Stealthy chapter tactic; if you selected that chapter tactic, you can do both of its options (retain two cover saves — one normal and one critical success).
effects.hint: When shot, ignore Saturate. Has Stealthy — and can use both Stealthy options if you picked it.

effects.name: Grenadier
effects.text: This operative can use frag and krak grenades (see universal equipment). Doing so doesn't count towards any limited uses you have. Whenever it's doing so, improve the Hit stat of that weapon by 1.
effects.hint: Uses frag and krak grenades free of their limited uses, at +1 Hit.

weapons.name: Bolt sniper rifle (executioner)
weapons.rules: Heavy (Dash only), Saturate, Seek Light, Silent

chapterTactics.name: Aggressive
chapterTactics.text: This operative’s melee weapons have the Rending weapon rule.

chapterTactics.name: Dueller
chapterTactics.text: Whenever fighting or retaliating, each of your normal successes can block one unresolved critical success (unless the enemy weapon has Brutal).
chapterTactics.hint: Dueller — your normal successes can block unresolved criticals (unless the enemy weapon has Brutal).

chapterTactics.name: Resolute
chapterTactics.text: Ignore any changes to this operative’s APL stat; it is not affected by enemy Shock.
chapterTactics.hint: Resolute — ignore APL changes, and ignore enemy Shock.

chapterTactics.name: Stealthy
chapterTactics.text: When enemies shoot this operative, if cover saves can be retained you may retain one additional cover save, or convert one to a critical success. Not cumulative with Vantage.
chapterTactics.hint: Stealthy — one extra cover save, or upgrade one to a critical (not with Vantage).

chapterTactics.name: Mobile
chapterTactics.text: Fall Back costs 1 less AP, and this operative can Charge while within enemy control range, breaking that range to do so.
chapterTactics.hint: Mobile — Fall Back for 1 less AP, and you can Charge out of enemy control range.

chapterTactics.name: Hardy
chapterTactics.text: Whenever an operative is shooting this operative, defence dice results of 5+ are critical successes.
chapterTactics.hint: Hardy — defence dice of 5+ are critical successes.

chapterTactics.name: Sharpshooter
chapterTactics.text: If this operative has not performed a Charge, Fall Back or Reposition action, its bolt weapons gain Accurate 1 and Severe.
chapterTactics.hint: Sharpshooter — bolt weapons gain Accurate 1 and Severe if you haven’t Charged, Fallen Back or Repositioned.

grantsWeaponRules.condition: if it hasn't Charged, Fallen Back or Repositioned this activation

chapterTactics.name: Siege Specialist
chapterTactics.text: Ranged weapons gain Saturate, and enemies cannot assist during this operative’s melee.
chapterTactics.hint: Siege Specialist — ranged weapons have Saturate; enemies cannot assist in your melee.
